144:
Product: BBROSE Ginkgo Mist countertop display stand, for the Ginkgo Mist
Hydrating Face Mist (30 ml clear glass bottle with a silver spray cap,
about 108 mm tall and 29 mm wide).
Arabic: رذاذ الوجه جينكو ميست.
Type: a printed cardboard countertop display stand holding 12 bottles
in 3 stepped rows of 4 (each row higher than the one in front, so every
bottle shows), each bottle in its own round hole about 31 mm wide, with
a tall back header panel above the top row and a low front lip.
Size: about 180 mm wide, 150 mm deep, 300 mm tall at the header.
Design, inspired by the uploaded references (the same look as the
bottle): soft dusty blue and cream; bold ginkgo leaf shapes in a deeper
blue with only a few simple veins, framing the header the way the
leaves frame the name in the reference; a few loose flowing ribbon
swirls across the side panels and the steps; an elegant tall serif
name. Flat vector style: no photos, no fine hairlines, no metallic
finishes, no embossing or die-cuts.
Header copy: BBROSE logo, "Ginkgo Mist", "Hydrating Face Mist / رذاذ
الوجه", "Calm. Fresh. Hydrated."
Front lip copy: "Ginkgo Mist · 30 ml ℮ 1.0 fl oz".
Sides: the swirl pattern with the BBROSE logo.
146:
Product: BBROSE Kiss Me countertop display stand, for the Kiss Me Lip
Gloss (square clear vial with a gold cap, about 98 mm tall and 16 mm
wide).
Arabic: ملمّع الشفاه كيس مي.
Type: a printed cardboard countertop display stand holding 12 glosses
in 3 stepped rows of 4 (each row higher than the one in front, so every
gloss shows), each in its own square hole about 18 mm wide, with a back
header panel above the top row and a low front lip.
Size: about 120 mm wide, 120 mm deep, 260 mm tall at the header.
Design, the same look as the gloss: a pink-to-cherry-red gradient, soft
kiss-print lips, the pink-and-berry leopard pattern as flat vector
spots on the sides and steps, a chunky retro display name and a script
tagline. Flat vector style: no photos, no watercolour, no metallic
finishes.
Header copy: BBROSE logo, "Kiss Me", "Lip Gloss / ملمّع الشفاه",
"Embrace the kissable you".
Front lip copy: "Kiss Me · 6 ml".
Sides: the leopard pattern with the BBROSE logo.
